saga: Y1 Steward Bertram the Steady: “The granary counts 40 measures — a season, no more. Plant a farm on open plains.”
Y1 Steward Bertram the Steady: “Every wall and roof to come is standing in that forest. A lumber camp — near the trees, while they last.”
Y1 The raiders have set up camp in the wilds — Wolf's Rest. For now, it is only a nest of brigands.
Y2 Steward Bertram the Steady: “You have swords enough to answer the warlord at the tents, sire — if you dare leave home thin.”
Y2 Steward Bertram the Steady: “When they mass at the tents, you have time yet. When the camp stirs — you do not.”
Y2 The war-camp stirs — Wolf's Rest may march soon.
Y3 The host marches on Wolf's Rest — 14 swords. The kingdom stands thinner behind them.
Y3 The host falls upon Wolf's Rest — and the war-band gathered at the tents turns to meet them!
Y3 The assault on Wolf's Rest is REPULSED — 9 of 14 lost. The warlord is emboldened.
Y3 The war-camp stirs — Wolf's Rest may march soon.
Y4 The host returns through the gates.
Y4 The host marches on Wolf's Rest — 24 swords. The kingdom stands thinner behind them.
Y5 The host falls upon Wolf's Rest! Battle is joined at the tents.
Y5 The camp is stripped bare — arm-rings and weapons off the dead: 25 gold, 20 goods.
Y5 One slips through the reeds — Wren, a cook. Remember the name: Wren.
Y5 Wolf's Rest is no more. 8 souls. The Chronicle will keep their names even if you will not.
Y5 23 of your soldiers come home marked by the burning. Nothing frightens them now — and they will never lay down the sword.
Y5 The host returns from the ashes of Wolf's Rest. No songs are sung.
Y5 The axes fall silent at a lumber camp — the wood nearby is spent. The cleared land lies open.
Y5 The lumber camp at the spent ground is struck — its timbers come home.
Y5 Steward Bertram the Steady: “The ground there is spent, and the camp struck itself — the timbers are already home. The land lies open for the plough now. Follow the forest.”
Y5 The axes fall silent at a lumber camp — the wood nearby is spent. The cleared land lies open.
Y5 The lumber camp at the spent ground is struck — its timbers come home.
